title: Amadeus connection: settings, live access, own credentials
caption: PF-50 to PF-53. Owners and admins change; finance reads.

steps.title: Read the cards
steps.body: One card per environment, test first.
steps.expect: "Velexis test account, office DEV1A00xx, active" (locally the dev offices). An empty pool shows `pending_verification` with the explanation.

steps.title: Settings
steps.body: Change the default/queuing/owner office, the ticketing agreement and delay, automated processes (≤31) and monitored queues (≤20), **Save**.
steps.expect: "saved" with the new version; `supplier_connections.ticketing_defaults`/`monitored_queues` and `version` change. A stale tab gets PRECONDITION_FAILED with "Reload the page".

steps.title: Request live access
steps.body: With `FEATURE_LIVE_SWITCH` on and a plan with `liveMode`: optional note, **Request live access**.
steps.expect: "Velexis has your request for live access"; a live card "Velexis live account, no office yet, pending"; ops e-mailed.

steps.title: Own credentials
steps.body: With `FEATURE_OWN_AMADEUS` on: **Use my own Amadeus credentials**, client id, secret, office ids; step-up.
steps.expect: 202 then "being verified"; `credential_submissions` row; final applied/failed in words; secret field emptied.
